about.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

body: Thank you for using Orca and sharing your feedback. ❤️ ## Even better Agy support, cleaner phone screens & per-agent Google accounts ✨ - 🚀 **Antigravity (Agy) gets even better.** Find installed plugin skills in the chat’s `/` menu before your first message, and choose **Approve for me** in Agy terminals. - 🤖 **Manage bot conversations in Slack.** Ask a bot to leave a thread and @mention it to bring it back. Follow-ups return to the thread they started in. - 🎨 **Recognize your bot in Slack.** Its icon shows its mascot’s colour and outfit. - 🗓️ **Manage bot automations from Activity.** Delete an automation directly from your bot’s Activity panel. - 📱 **Do more from the phone.** Screens use one clean list style. Sign in to Google, GitHub and Linear, answer an item's question in the chat, and use the mic in group rooms. - ✅ **Answer questions in one go.** See every open question on an item and send the answers you pick together. Comments stay compact until you focus them. - 🔑 **Choose Google accounts per agent.** Pick which Google accounts each agent uses, stop a setup in progress, and see why a sign-in failed. - 🗂️ **Find and tidy workspaces.** Project badges identify workspaces in the sidebar. Workspace cleanup groups what is safe to delete, asks before deleting and keeps going in the background. - 💬 **Get around a chat faster.** Search a chat's messages from the rail, see workers as a small pill above the message box, and keep a reply's text visible while the agent thinks. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots are agents you can ask to handle ongoing work. They can coordinate agents and workers across your computers, connect to your apps, and run tasks on a schedule or when something happens. ## Coming soon - More connectors - Easier moves for bots between computers - More performance improvements - Improvements to pull request review, plugins and the sidebar --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Ask a bot to leave a Slack thread, delete automations from a bot's panel, and choose which Google accounts each agent can use.* * Ask an Orca bot to leave a Slack thread; @mention it to bring it back by @brennanb2025 in print the NO_REPLY marker in group chat turns by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48496 * fix(bots): a thread's follow-up goes back to the thread it started in by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/47789 * Keep a quiet Slack bot reply quiet when Orca restarts mid-upgrade by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48164 * fix(connector): a turn the owner typed acts for the owner in Slack actions by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/48431 * Delete a bot's automation from its Activity panel by @AmethystLiang in
